title: Grateful Dead Live at Moscone Convention Center on 1982-05-28
lineage: 1st gen analog Nakamichi 300 shotguns > Sony D-5; Nakamichi DR-3 > Apogee AD-1000 > EGO-SYS WT2496 (soundcard) > Soundforge 4.5 > CDWAVE > Mkwact

ai_review.summary: Clear audience tape that captures a high‑energy second set featuring Boz Scaggs & John Cippolina, despite the venue’s muffled acoustics.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise the recording for its crystal‑clear leads and excellent mic work (Nakamichi), noting only occasional vocal dropouts and a generally muffled arena sound. Musically the show shines in the second set – fast‑paced Walkin' Blues, a ripping Death Letter Blues, a fiery Not Fade Away and an impassioned Lovelight with guest blues players make it a standout performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 4‑star reviews highlight strong musical moments and a high‑quality audience recording, giving consistent positive feedback.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Leads and drums are crystal clear thanks to the Nakamichi mic; venue acoustics cause some muffling and a few vocal drop‑outs (Jerry’s vocals missing on GDTRFB).

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is unremarkable, but the second set bursts with guest‑driven blues/rock energy and tight transitions, making the overall flow feel very strong.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Rips multiple solos (Not Fade Away, Death Letter Blues, Lovelight) and delivers a powerful lead; vocals are missing on some songs early in the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is solid and audible, especially during the Space segment.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland shines with Hammond B3 solos and prominent keyboard presence throughout the second set.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are crystal clear; quick, tight playing noted on Lovelight and other fast‑tempo numbers.
